name: heimdall_v2_hold_invariants
notes: heimdall_v2 with TEST_HOLD_EVERY=8 (default), 16 non-zero-sector reads: every 8th insert held. bpftool hm_v2_stats should show test_held >= 1, held_enqueued >= 1. NOTE: field is test_held, NOT held_total. trace must use non-zero sectors (sector 0 bypasses test rule).
